title: Grateful Dead Live at Merramec Community College on 1970-05-14
lineage: DAT > CDR > EAC > FLAC (with portions from MSR > MP3 > WAV > FLAC)

ai_review.summary: Rough and furious Lovelights captured on a soundboard recording that delivers one of the best performances of the song despite some editing quirks.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as possibly the best ever heard of "Lovelight", delivering a rough, rowdy, fast‑and‑furious energy. The soundboard source provides clear enough detail to hear the spontaneous Pig shout after the drum outro, though other copies appear edited. Overall it’s a high‑energy performance that shines even if minor post‑production edits exist.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review highlights an exceptional performance of Lovelight and a generally good soundboard recording; limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Rough, rowdy sound with clear capture of the Pig shout after Lovelight's drum outro; some versions show edited crowd cheering, suggesting minor post‑production edits.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fast‑paced and high‑energy throughout, with the Lovelight ending featuring an unplanned Pig shout that adds to the rowdy vibe.
